scope: Authenticated single-host dashboard platform on the standalone QBench distribution

other_gates.approved_imagenet_folder_integration: passed with a generated one-image fixture, not pretrained acceptance

limitations: The GPU suite skips opt-in pretrained public-model ImageNet acceptance; CPU also skips seven GPU-only tests.
No independent hardware-fidelity evidence or representative target-GPU overhead certification was added.
This is one trusted host and one process, not a hostile-code sandbox or distributed scheduler.
Public deployment, HTTPS/proxy setup, load/penetration testing, SSO, MFA and email delivery were not performed.
Existing container and two installed environments were tested; a new container image and broad dependency-version matrix were not tested.
